claims.text: Opened in September 2008.
The resort is set on a private motu (island) in the string of coral islets surrounding Bora Bora's main island.

findings.quote: Set on a private motu (island) in the string of coral islets surrounding Bora Bora's main island, and overlooking Mount Otemanu and Mount Pahia

claims.text: The resort overlooks Mount Otemanu and Mount Pahia.

findings.quote: Set on a private motu (island) in the string of coral islets surrounding Bora Bora's main island, and overlooking Mount Otemanu and Mount Pahia

claims.text: The resort is a 15-minute boat ride from Bora Bora Airport.

findings.quote: A 15-minute boat ride from Bora Bora Airport, our Resort is located on a private motu (islet) in French Polynesia’s Leeward Islands along a tranquil turquoise lagoon.

claims.text: Arii Moana offers classics from the Mediterranean region.

findings.quote: Arii Moana offers a casually elegant dining experience, featuring classics from the Mediterranean region.

claims.text: Fare Hoa Beach Bar & Restaurant is an open-air restaurant on the sandy shore of the lagoon.

findings.quote: Set on the sandy shore of the lagoon, Fare Hoa Beach Bar & Restaurant is an open-air restaurant with toes-in-the-sand charm.

claims.text: Vaimiti offers an overwater setting for eclectic Asian cuisine.

findings.quote: Vaimiti offers an idyllic overwater setting for eclectic Asian cuisine and sunset cocktails.

claims.text: Te Mahana Spa has seven treatment rooms, including two open-air pavilions.

findings.quote: Raised walkways above pandanus trees lead to the Spa’s seven treatment rooms, including two open-air pavilions and the signature overwater Fare Miti Spa Suite for couples.
findings.note: Seven rooms incl. two open-air pavilions

claims.text: The resort has two artificial grass tennis courts.

findings.quote: Enjoy views of mystical Mount Otemanu and lush tropical beauty surrounding our Resort’s two artificial grass courts as you practise your backhand.

claims.text: The resort has a Kids for All Seasons program.
The One-Bedroom Otemanu Overwater Bungalow Suite With Plunge Pool lets you step straight into the lagoon from your own private deck.

findings.quote: Hop from your bedroom to your plunge pool and step straight into the lagoon from your own private deck.
findings.note: Listed under the One-Bedroom Otemanu Overwater Bungalow Suite With Plunge Pool heading

claims.text: The Three-Bedroom Premier Beachfront Villa Estate has a secluded beachfront setting spanning over a full acre (0.4 hectares).

findings.quote: full outdoor kitchen and secluded beachfront setting spanning over a full acre (0.4 hectares) of pristine white-sand beach.
findings.note: Under Three-Bedroom Premier Beachfront Villa Estate heading

claims.text: Private Dinner on the Motu starts with a boat ride by outrigger canoe to a private white-sand motu, where guests are greeted with champagne, followed by a gourmet dinner at sunset.

findings.quote: Board an outrigger canoe to a private white-sand motu (islet) where you'll be greeted with champagne, followed by a gourmet dinner at sunset.

claims.text: In the Overwater Spa Suite, treatment beds sit on glass panels above the lagoon.

findings.quote: Unwind in the ultimate couples’ suite, where treatment beds sit on glass panels above the lagoon and the outdoor tub overlooks Mount Otemanu.

claims.text: Guests are responsible for booking their own flights to Bora Bora, including the interisland flights from Papeete, Tahiti.

findings.quote: Guests are responsible for booking their own flights to Bora Bora, including the interisland flights from Papeete, Tahiti to Bora Bora.

claims.text: Interisland flights may not operate during the late-night or very early hours, so an overnight stay in Tahiti may be required.

findings.quote: Please note that the interisland flights may not operate during the late-night or very early hours; therefore, an overnight stay in Tahiti may be required, depending on your arrival or departure time from Faa’a International Airport.

claims.text: Condé Nast Traveler says the majority of guests are well-heeled couples there to celebrate the bigger moments in life.

findings.quote: the majority of the guests are well-heeled couples there to celebrate the bigger moments in life.

claims.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
